title: Run the Busywork of a YouTube Channel
summary: Transcripts, chapters, titles, descriptions and thumbnails after every upload, plus posts and clips for X.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes the channel already earns from ads or sponsors; more and better uploads compound over time.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: You publish more often with the same hours.
Better titles, chapters and thumbnails help each video find viewers.
who_its_for: YouTubers and podcasters who publish weekly.
